notice: Hand-picked editorial examples, not live recommendations.

items.title: Perfect Days
items.blurb: A quiet character study built from work, music and repeated daily rituals. A good door into films where attention matters more than plot machinery.

items.title: Aftersun
items.blurb: A daughter looks back at a holiday with her father, where small remembered moments slowly acquire a different weight.

items.title: Detectorists
items.blurb: Two friends search fields for buried history while ordinary life keeps interrupting. Gentle, funny television with a precise sense of place.

items.title: Happy Valley
items.blurb: A police sergeant confronts a case that reaches into her own family history. Tense crime drama anchored by character rather than spectacle.

items.title: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End
items.blurb: After the heroes have already won, an elf begins to understand how differently her human companions experienced their time together.

items.title: The Apothecary Diaries
items.blurb: A sharp-minded apothecary solves medical puzzles and court intrigues while trying not to attract more attention than necessary.

items.title: Lahai — Sampha
items.blurb: Restless, intimate songs that reward a full-album listen, moving between electronic detail, family memory and warm piano lines.

items.title: My 21st Century Blues — RAYE
items.blurb: A wide-ranging debut album that moves through pop, soul, jazz and dance music without sanding down its sharper personal edges.
